title: Add skill type anytime through events or plugin?

posts.author: RagnarokAesthetic
posts.body:
[RPG MAKER MZ]
Hi All,
I am looking for a solution to add skill types without changing the class of a character.
For example I would like to have a "summon" branch for skill types but not allow it to be visible at the beginning of the game.
When the player would do a certain quest or obtain a certain item they would get this skill type.
Is this possible or is there some sort of plugin?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Please search for a plugin for "dynamic traits", there are several.
Those will allow you to add any traits during gametime, including the skill type traits
EDIT: that "there are several" was based on your preferred use of MV. If you're looking for a MZ plugin, then there should be something similar but I can't guarantee they exist as I haven't used MZ so far.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
If it's tied to an item, you can put the Add Skill Type trait on the weapon or armor, the actor will get it as long as they have it equipped.
I dunno why you care about changing the class, it's really simple to create a second copy of the class that has the extra skill type.
Or you can use a plugin that gives passive states, give that state the Add Skill Type trait, and turn it on with a switch at the given story point.
